title: DriveUniTok: A Unified Multimodal Tokenizer for Driving World-Action Models
title_zh: DriveUniTok：面向驾驶世界-动作模型的统一多模态分词器

paragraphs.en: World models are emerging as a fundamental component of policy learning for real-world agents, enabling agents to predict future world states and plan actions within a learned representation of the dynamic environment. Existing approaches, however, often model appearance, metric geometry represented by projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion either partially or independently, overlooking the fact that these modalities are different projections of a shared underlying world state. This separation can lead to information loss and cross-modal inconsistency, ultimately limiting downstream performance. Motivated by this unified view of the world, we propose DriveUniTok , a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes these modalities in a single decodable continuous latent. We freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model, DriveUniWAM , to predict future unified latents; the tokenizer then decodes them into future appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that our unified design achieves better future prediction and planning performance at lower downstream computational cost than separate-stream alternatives. With reinforcement learning post-training, DriveUniWAM achieves a PDMS of 91.54, reaching state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated WAM-based planners.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型正在成为真实世界智能体策略学习的基础组件，使智能体能够预测未来的世界状态，并在学到的动态环境表示中规划动作。 然而，现有方法往往只是部分地或相互独立地建模外观、以投影激光雷达深度表示的度量几何以及自车运动，忽视了这些模态实际上是同一个共享底层世界状态的不同投影这一事实。 这种割裂可能导致信息丢失和跨模态不一致，最终限制下游性能。 受这种统一世界观的启发，我们提出 DriveUniTok，一种面向驾驶世界-动作模型（WAMs）的统一多模态分词器，它将这些模态编码在单一可解码的连续潜在空间中。 我们冻结 DriveUniTok，并对预训练扩散模型 DriveUniWAM 进行适配，使其预测未来的统一潜在表示；随后分词器将其解码为未来的外观、投影激光雷达深度以及自车轨迹。 在 NAVSIM 上的实验表明，与分离式流方案相比，我们的统一设计以更低的下游计算成本实现了更好的未来预测和规划性能。 通过强化学习后训练，DriveUniWAM 达到了 91.54 的 PDMS，在被评估的基于 WAM 的规划器中取得了最先进的性能。

paragraphs.en: Driving world models initially served as scene simulators and data engines, forecasting future observations for data augmentation and policy training. More recently, generative models of future observations have been integrated into policy backbones that jointly model scene evolution and ego trajectories ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . In this setting, the latent representation is no longer merely an interface for visual reconstruction; it is the space in which the model captures the information required for both future prediction and planning.
paragraphs.zh: 早期驾驶世界模型主要作为场景模拟器和数据引擎，通过预测未来观测来服务数据增强和策略训练。 近来，未来观测的生成模型已被集成到策略骨干中，以联合建模场景演化与自车轨迹（Zhang et al., 2025b；Zhao et al., 2025；Xia et al., 2026；Shi et al., 2026）。 在这一设定下，潜在表示不再仅仅是视觉重建的接口，而是模型捕获未来预测和规划所需信息的空间。

paragraphs.en: Existing world-action models, however, expose asymmetric representation interfaces. Most inherit a pretrained RGB video autoencoder whose latent primarily captures appearance, while geometry is introduced through auxiliary supervision and ego pose remains outside the latent, where it is handled by a separate conditioning stream or action head ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ) . Driving tokenizers fuse camera and LiDAR observations into scene-centric bird’s-eye-view latents, but still leave ego pose outside the scene representation ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Chen & Zhao, 2025 ; Zhuo et al., 2026 ; Liao et al., 2025b ) . Cross-modal and latent-action tokenizers incorporate actions alongside observations, yet commonly retain modality-specific streams or align them through a designated anchor or intermediary representation ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Bachmann et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025a ; Fan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Figure 1 compares these representations according to whether appearance, metric geometry, and ego pose reside in the same decodable latent.

Therefore, a central question arises: Should visual appearance, metric geometry, and ego-motion be represented within a unified tokenization framework? DriveUniTok addresses this question by encoding RGB appearance, projected LiDAR geometry, and clip-relative ego pose in one jointly decodable latent.
paragraphs.zh: 这种不对称性迫使下游预测器在学习跨模态对应关系的同时还要学习时间演化，这可能导致未来场景预测与自车轨迹预测不一致。 因此，一个核心问题随之而来：视觉外观、度量几何与自车运动是否应该在一个统一的词元化框架中表示？ DriveUniTok 通过在同一个可联合解码的潜在表示中编码 RGB 外观、投影后的 LiDAR 几何以及相对片段的自车位姿来回答这一问题。

paragraphs.en: To construct such a representation, we propose DriveUniTok , a query-based multimodal tokenizer. Shared learnable queries aggregate appearance features from RGB, metric geometry features from projected LiDAR depth, and clip-relative ego-pose features into a common sequence of per-frame multimodal tokens. A causal temporal compressor then maps this sequence into a compact continuous unified latent. All three modalities are reconstructed from the shared bottleneck through modality-specific readouts, without using a privileged anchor modality. In addition, a training-only semantic decoder is supervised by representations from a vision foundation model, encouraging the unified latent to preserve high-level scene semantics alongside metric geometry and pose.
paragraphs.zh: 为构建这样一种表示，我们提出了 DriveUniTok，一种基于查询的多模态分词器。 共享的可学习查询将来自 RGB 的外观特征、来自投影激光雷达深度的度量几何特征，以及相对片段的自车位姿特征聚合到一个通用的逐帧多模态 token 序列中。 随后，因果时间压缩器将该序列映射为一个紧凑的连续统一潜变量。 三种模态均通过模态专属的读取头从共享瓶颈中重建，而不使用特权锚定模态。 此外，一个仅用于训练的语义解码器由视觉基础模型的表示进行监督，促使统一潜变量在保留度量几何与位姿的同时，也保留高层场景语义。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether this representation supports joint forecasting and planning, we freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model into DriveUniWAM , using the same downstream backbone and training protocol for unified and separate representations. The Wan-initialized flow-matching transformer predicts future unified latents under block-causal attention, conditioned on DriveUniTok-encoded historical observations and clip-relative ego poses together with a navigation signal. Future RGB, depth, and ego trajectories are decoded from the same predicted latent evolution rather than generated through independent observation and action pathways. Because supervised flow matching fits recorded futures but does not directly optimize the NAVSIM planning metric, we additionally post-train DriveUniWAM with GRPO against the PDM reward while regularizing it toward the supervised reference model.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估这种表征是否能够支持联合预测与规划，我们冻结 DriveUniTok，并将一个预训练扩散模型适配为 DriveUniWAM，对统一表征与分离表征使用相同的下游骨干网络和训练协议。 以 Wan 初始化的流匹配 transformer 在块因果注意力下预测未来的统一隐变量，其条件为 DriveUniTok 编码的历史观测、相对于片段的自车位姿以及导航信号。 未来的 RGB、深度和自车轨迹都从同一个预测的隐变量演化中解码出来，而不是通过相互独立的观测与动作通路分别生成。 由于监督式流匹配只能拟合已记录的未来而无法直接优化 NAVSIM 规划指标，我们进一步使用 GRPO 针对 PDM 奖励对 DriveUniWAM 进行后训练，同时使其向监督参考模型正则化。

paragraphs.en: For visual tokenizers, discrete codebooks are commonly paired with autoregressive or masked token prediction ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) , whereas continuous latents are often used with diffusion and flow-matching models. Large video VAEs provide high-fidelity latent spaces for RGB generation ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , and quantization and model design materially affect representation quality ( Luo et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Tang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . General-purpose multimodal tokenizers place vision, language, audio, and other signals in a shared token space through semantic or contrastive objectives ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Bachmann et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) . These tokenizers, however, are optimized for general visual generation or cross-modal alignment, and do not explicitly capture the metric geometry or ego motion required for driving scenes. Driving-specific tokenizers instead focus on scene representations. BEV-VAE and DriveTok construct tokens from multiview observations ( Chen & Zhao, 2025 ; Zhuo et al., 2026 ) , while OccWorld and I 2 I^{2} -World tokenize structured 3D occupancy for world modeling and 4D forecasting ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2025b ) . Moving beyond camera- or occupancy-centric scene tokens, BEVWorld fuses surround-view images and LiDAR into a BEV latent that can be rendered back to both modalities, but the latent still describes the scene without encoding ego pose ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . These limitations motivate a unified tokenizer that keeps appearance, metric geometry, and ego pose jointly decodable.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end driving systems jointly optimize perception and planning, from feature fusion and waypoint regression ( Chitta et al., 2023 ) and planning-centric perception and prediction ( Hu et al., 2023 ) to anchored trajectory sets refined by truncated diffusion ( Liao et al., 2025a ) or autoregressive mixture-of-experts decoding ( Feng et al., 2025 ) . World-model-assisted planners expose future-scene information through future rollouts, predicted BEV features, or world-objective constraints on the planning latent ( Li et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Vision-language-action planners add semantic priors and explicit reasoning, using either chain-of-thought reasoning with discrete action tokens or language-derived representations with diffusion planning and reward refinement ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026a ) , and recent variants further incorporate generated futures through interleaved generation, latent conditioning, iterative replanning, or auxiliary supervision ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Zuo et al., 2026a ; Sheng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . These planners use future information in different ways, but generally treat future-scene prediction and trajectory generation as separate modeling components.
paragraphs.zh: 端到端驾驶系统联合优化感知与规划，从特征融合与路径点回归（Chitta et al., 2023）、以规划为中心的感知与预测（Hu et al., 2023），到通过截断扩散（Liao et al., 2025a）或自回归混合专家解码（Feng et al., 2025）精炼的锚定轨迹集合。 世界模型辅助的规划器通过未来推演、预测的BEV特征或作用于规划潜变量的世界目标约束来揭示未来场景信息（Li et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a；Yang et al., 2026）。 视觉-语言-动作规划器引入语义先验与显式推理，或采用带离散动作token的思维链推理，或采用结合扩散规划与奖励精炼的语言派生表示（Zhou et al., 2025；Li et al., 2026d；Li et al., 2026a），近期的变体进一步通过交错生成、潜变量条件化、迭代重规划或辅助监督融入生成的未来信息（Liu et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026b；Zuo et al., 2026a；Sheng et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026c；Zhou et al., 2026）。 这些规划器以不同方式利用未来信息，但通常将未来场景预测与轨迹生成视为相互独立的建模组件。

paragraphs.en: World-action models instead couple the two within a generative model. Existing world-action models differ primarily in how predicted future observations interact with trajectory generation. Some use parallel diffusion heads over a shared spatiotemporal latent ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) or attention over discrete future-frame tokens in an autoregressive sequence ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , while others condition action transformers on cached video-denoising features ( Xia et al., 2026 ) , decode action chunks from a sampled future-video latent ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , or autoregressively interleave scene and action tokens ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) . paragraphs.en: DriveUniTok constructs the unified latent used by DriveUniWAM through three components: a query-based multimodal encoder that fuses the three modalities within each frame, a temporal compressor that reduces the T T per-frame states of a sequence to one, and a shared decoder in which one set of mask tokens per target reads all three modalities back out of the compressed latent.
paragraphs.zh: DriveUniTok 通过三个组件构建 DriveUniWAM 所使用的统一潜在表示：一个基于查询的多模态编码器，用于融合每一帧内的三种模态；一个时间压缩器，将序列的 T T 个逐帧状态压缩为一；以及一个共享解码器，其中每个目标使用一组掩码令牌从压缩后的潜在表示中读取全部三种模态。

paragraphs.en: Each input stream is first converted into features. RGB frames pass through a frozen DINOv3-L backbone ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , which yields a multilevel feature hierarchy. Rather than using a separate geometric backbone, we project the LiDAR sweep onto the image plane and process the resulting sparse depth map in the same feature space as RGB. The shared queries then extract appearance and geometric evidence through the same deformable-attention mechanism. The sparse depth map receives its own single-channel patch embedding, and the resulting tokens pass through the same frozen DINOv3 blocks with a learned modality embedding. Relative poses are mapped by a trainable ego state encoder into N E = 8 N_{E}=8 ego tokens. paragraphs.en: Consecutive frames of a sequence are highly redundant, and keeping one latent per frame would make the downstream token sequence T T times longer at quadratic attention cost. Each of the S S queries produces one state per frame, and we compress those T T states into one, independently for every query. Causal self-attention first processes the T T states in order, then a learned pooling query gathers them into a single sequence-level state, which a Gaussian bottleneck ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ) maps to the d d -dimensional code that forms z z . Because depth and ego evidence are written into these shared queries rather than into token streams of their own, a sequence yields S S tokens regardless of how many modalities it carries, roughly half of what separate per-modality representations would need. This gives DriveUniWAM a compact fixed-length latent in which appearance, geometry, and ego motion can be modeled together, while avoiding the duplicated token streams required by separate representations.

paragraphs.en: DriveUniWAM follows the world-action model formulation introduced by DreamZero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Rather than forecasting observations and leaving action generation to a separate planner, it predicts future observations and actions within one generative process, so the imagined scene evolution and the executable action share a common dynamics representation. The central role of DriveUniTok is therefore to provide a latent in which the variables needed for world-action modeling are already jointly organized. Existing world-action models commonly inherit an RGB video latent and add action tokens beside it, leaving the model to discover the correspondence between appearance and motion during training. In DriveUniWAM that correspondence is already established by the frozen DriveUniTok latent, so the denoiser learns the evolution of an aligned driving state instead of simultaneously learning two prediction tasks and their correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: DriveUniWAM 遵循 DreamZero（Ye et al., 2026）提出的世界-动作模型（world-action model）表述。 它不是先预测观测、再把动作生成留给单独的规划器，而是在同一个生成过程中同时预测未来观测与动作，因此想象出的场景演化与可执行动作共享同一动力学表征。 因此，DriveUniTok 的核心作用是提供一个隐空间，其中世界-动作建模所需的变量已经被联合组织好。 现有的世界-动作模型通常沿用 RGB 视频隐表示，并在其旁添加动作 token，让模型在训练过程中自行发现外观与运动之间的对应关系。 而在 DriveUniWAM 中，这种对应关系已由冻结的 DriveUniTok 隐表示预先建立，因此去噪器学习的是对齐驾驶状态的演化，而不是同时学习两个预测任务及其对应关系。

sents.en: Rather than forecasting observations and leaving action generation to a separate planner, it predicts future observations and actions within one generative process, so the imagined scene evolution and the executable action share a common dynamics representation.

sents.en: The central role of DriveUniTok is therefore to provide a latent in which the variables needed for world-action modeling are already jointly organized.
sents.zh: 因此，DriveUniTok 的核心作用是提供一个隐空间，其中世界-动作建模所需的变量已经被联合组织好。

sents.en: Existing world-action models commonly inherit an RGB video latent and add action tokens beside it, leaving the model to discover the correspondence between appearance and motion during training.
sents.zh: 现有的世界-动作模型通常沿用 RGB 视频隐表示，并在其旁添加动作 token，让模型在训练过程中自行发现外观与运动之间的对应关系。

sents.en: In DriveUniWAM that correspondence is already established by the frozen DriveUniTok latent, so the denoiser learns the evolution of an aligned driving state instead of simultaneously learning two prediction tasks and their correspondence.
sents.zh: 而在 DriveUniWAM 中，这种对应关系已由冻结的 DriveUniTok 隐表示预先建立，因此去噪器学习的是对齐驾驶状态的演化，而不是同时学习两个预测任务及其对应关系。

paragraphs.en: DriveUniWAM uses the frozen DriveUniTok to encode the K K observed and F F future sequences. The history latents provide clean context, while the future latents are corrupted and reconstructed. We initialize the denoiser from the pretrained Wan2.2-TI2V-5B model ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) and adapt only its input and output projections to the DriveUniTok latent; a navigation embedding conditions it on the current vehicle state and route command. History queries attend only to history tokens, so the clean context cannot read noisy future targets, while every future query attends to the complete joint sequence, making all future tokens mutually visible during denoising. That visibility is what DriveUniTok makes reasonable, because each token already carries evidence from aligned appearance, geometry, and ego motion, so no artificial factorization between future observation and future action is needed.

paragraphs.en: Flow matching fits recorded futures, whereas NAVSIM scores the consequences of a planned trajectory. We therefore post-train DriveUniWAM with Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025 ) against the NAVSIM PDM reward ( Dauner et al., 2024 ) , as shown in Figure 3 (b). For each scene the policy samples a group of joint futures, the frozen decoder reads a trajectory out of each sampled latent, and the group rewards give relative advantages for a clipped policy update regularized toward the supervised reference model. Only LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) in the denoiser are trained; DriveUniTok, its decoder, and the reference policy stay frozen, so any gain reflects policy optimization around a fixed decodable latent rather than a change to the representation. Appendix C.2 states the full reward, transition replay, reference BC objective, and hyperparameters.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate multimodal reconstruction, joint future prediction, and planning. DriveUniTok encodes front-camera RGB, projected LiDAR depth, and clip-relative ego poses into 584 tokens. Visual reconstruction uses VGG- and DINOv3-based LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and I3D- and V-JEPA 2.1-based FVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ; Carreira and Zisserman, 2017 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) ; depth uses MAE, AbsRel, and RMSE, and ego motion uses ADE and FDE. Planning uses no-at-fault collisions (NC), drivable-area compliance (DAC), ego progress (EP), time to collision (TTC), comfort, and PDMS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估多模态重建、联合未来预测与规划。 DriveUniTok 将前视相机 RGB、投影后的 LiDAR 深度以及相对片段的自身位姿编码为 584 个 token。 视觉重建采用基于 VGG 和 DINOv3 的 LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018；Siméoni et al., 2025）、PSNR、SSIM（Wang et al., 2004），以及基于 I3D 和 V-JEPA 2.1 的 FVD（Unterthiner et al., 2019；Carreira and Zisserman, 2017；Mur-Labadia et al., 2026）；深度采用 MAE、AbsRel 和 RMSE，自身运动采用 ADE 和 FDE。 规划采用无过错碰撞（NC）、可行驶区域合规（DAC）、自身进度（EP）、碰撞时间（TTC）、舒适度以及 PDMS。

paragraphs.en: We first test whether the compact unified latent preserves useful visual and temporal information by comparing DriveUniTok with large-scale pretrained video VAEs and benchmark-scale tokenizers under a common NAVSIM navtest protocol. Baselines use official preprocessing and native temporal windows, and each source frame is evaluated at most once. Visual baselines encode RGB only, whereas DriveUniTok encodes RGB, depth, and ego pose with frozen DINOv3-L features. We report native grid compression and DriveUniTok’s 584-token multimodal sequence separately to characterize fidelity–compression trade-offs under each tokenizer’s native configuration. Section 4.3 further compares unified and separate tokenization under matched representation and downstream computation budgets. Results are given in Table 1 ; qualitative RGB and depth reconstructions are shown in Figures 4 – 6 in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先通过在统一的 NAVSIM navtest 协议下，将 DriveUniTok 与大规模预训练视频 VAE 以及基准规模的分词器进行比较，来检验这种紧凑的统一潜在表示是否保留了有用的视觉与时序信息。 各基线使用官方预处理及其原生时间窗口，并且每个源帧最多被评估一次。 视觉基线仅编码 RGB，而 DriveUniTok 则使用冻结的 DINOv3-L 特征编码 RGB、深度与自车位姿。 我们分别报告原生网格压缩率与 DriveUniTok 的 584 个词元的多模态序列，以刻画每种分词器在其原生配置下的保真度—压缩率权衡。 第 4.3 节进一步在匹配的表示与下游计算预算下比较统一分词与分离分词。 结果见表 1；定性的 RGB 与深度重建结果见附录 B 中的图 4–6。

paragraphs.en: DriveUniTok attains the lowest LPIPS DINO (0.1063) and rFVD VJ (3.4546) among benchmark-scale methods, improving over the respective second-best results by 18.7% and 39.7%. Large pretrained VAEs retain an advantage on pixel-oriented metrics, but do not encode geometry or ego motion. These results indicate that the compact multimodal latent preserves useful semantic and temporal information without allocating separate modality-specific token streams. We next evaluate whether this representation also benefits future prediction and planning when used by a WAM.

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate the performance and resource efficiency of unified tokenization against separate modality-specific designs for WAM prediction and planning. We compare DriveUniTok against two separate-stream controls that use the same sensors, data, DriveUniWAM backbone, and training protocol. The natural-budget control assigns a full query budget to each modality and measures the resource efficiency of the unified design. The equal-budget control uses 288 RGB, 288 depth, and 8 ego queries, matching DriveUniTok’s 584 tokens, d = 16 d=16 latent width, 9,344 latent scalars, sequence length, and downstream computation. Both models use the same frozen DINOv3-L features, semantic supervision, mask-token reconstruction objective, optimization recipe, and downstream training protocol; their architectural difference combines latent organization, parameter sharing, and cross-modal connectivity. Further implementation details are provided in Appendix A . The complete comparison is reported in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们接下来针对 WAM 预测与规划，评估统一分词方案相对于各模态独立设计的性能与资源效率。 我们将 DriveUniTok 与两个分离流对照模型进行比较，它们使用相同的传感器、数据、DriveUniWAM 主干和训练协议。 自然预算对照为每个模态分配完整的查询预算，并衡量统一设计的资源效率。 等预算对照使用 288 个 RGB 查询、288 个深度查询和 8 个自车查询，与 DriveUniTok 的 584 个 token、d = 16 d=16 的潜在宽度、9,344 个潜在标量、序列长度以及下游计算量相匹配。 两个模型使用相同的冻结 DINOv3-L 特征、语义监督、掩码 token 重建目标、优化方案和下游训练协议；它们的架构差异综合了潜在组织方式、参数共享和跨模态连接方式。 更多实现细节见附录 A 。 完整的比较结果见表 2 。

paragraphs.en: Compared with the natural-budget control, DriveUniTok uses roughly half as many tokens and latent scalars, halves the sequence length, and reduces per-step DiT computation by about 52%, while improving PDMS from 90.1 to 91.0. At equal representation and DiT budgets, it uses fewer tokenizer parameters, reduces gFVD VJ by about 48%, future depth AbsRel by about 43%, and trajectory ADE by nearly 9%, and raises PDMS by 3.5 points to 91.0. These results support the unified design under both budget settings. Appendices D and F provide objective and input-modality ablations.

paragraphs.en: We presented DriveUniTok and DriveUniWAM for joint future-scene and ego-trajectory prediction through a unified multimodal latent. On NAVSIM, the unified design improves prediction and planning with fewer tokenizer parameters and lower downstream computational cost than the natural-budget separate-stream control. DriveUniWAM achieves 91.0 PDMS with supervised training and 91.54 after reinforcement learning post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DriveUniTok 和 DriveUniWAM，通过统一的多模态潜在表示实现联合的未来场景与自车轨迹预测。 在 NAVSIM 上，与自然预算的分离流控制相比，该统一设计以更少的分词器参数和更低的下游计算成本改进了预测与规划。 DriveUniWAM 在监督训练下达到 91.0 PDMS，经强化学习后训练后达到 91.54。

paragraphs.en: Each input is resized to 288 × 512 288\times 512 and divided into patches of size 16 16 , yielding an 18 × 32 18\times 32 grid. The encoder is initialized with N I = 576 N_{I}=576 queries with spatial reference points and N E = 8 N_{E}=8 queries with learned reference points, all with embedding width 1024 1024 . These query groups differ in initialization rather than modality: after joint attention, they form one unified sequence of S = 584 S=584 tokens, with every token able to carry evidence from RGB, depth, and ego motion. The DINOv3-L feature backbone is initialized from a pretrained checkpoint and kept frozen throughout tokenizer training; the separate DINOv3 semantic teacher is also frozen. The encoder contains two query layers; each layer applies joint self-attention over the S S queries followed by deformable cross-attention ( Zhu et al., 2021 ) over the RGB and depth feature hierarchies. We use four feature levels, four sampling points per level, and 16 16 attention heads. Reference points for the first query group are fixed at patch-grid centers, whereas the second query group uses learned reference points because it has no spatial prior.
paragraphs.zh: 每个输入被调整为 288 × 512 288\times 512 的尺寸，并被划分为大小为 16 16 的图块，从而得到一个 18 × 32 18\times 32 的网格。 编码器使用带有空间参考点的 N I = 576 N_{I}=576 个查询以及带有可学习参考点的 N E = 8 N_{E}=8 个查询进行初始化，所有查询的嵌入宽度均为 1024 1024 。 这些查询组在初始化上而非模态上有所不同：在联合注意力之后，它们形成一个由 S = 584 S=584 个词元组成的统一序列，每个词元都能够携带来自 RGB、深度和自体运动的信息。 DINOv3-L 特征骨干网络从预训练检查点初始化，并在词元化器训练期间保持冻结；独立的 DINOv3 语义教师模型也保持冻结。 编码器包含两个查询层；每一层先对 S S 个查询施加联合自注意力，随后在 RGB 和深度特征层级上施加可变形交叉注意力（ Zhu et al., 2021 ）。 我们使用四个特征层级、每个层级四个采样点以及 16 16 个注意力头。 第一个查询组的参考点固定在图块网格中心，而第二个查询组由于没有空间先验，因此使用可学习的参考点。

paragraphs.en: Temporal compression and expansion each use two causal self-attention blocks. The T T states of each unified query are temporally pooled into one sequence-level state and passed through a Variational Latent Bottleneck (VLB), which compresses the state to width d = 16 d=16 . Thus, DriveUniTok produces one unified z ∈ ℝ S × 16 z\in\mathbb{R}^{S\times 16} rather than separate image and ego latents. The decoder maps this latent back to width 1024 1024 and applies 24 24 shared ViT blocks with 16 16 heads and full self-attention. Four sets of mask tokens read the shared decoder features; the RGB and depth branches use convolutional decoders with channel multipliers [ 1 , 1 , 2 , 2 , 4 ] [1,1,2,2,4] and two residual blocks per stage. We optimize all trainable tokenizer modules with AdamW at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay 0.01 0.01 , clip gradients at norm 10 10 , and use warmup followed by a cosine schedule. The query-aggregator parameter group uses a 0.1 × 0.1\times learning-rate multiplier. All DINOv3 parameters receive no gradient updates. This unified latent is the representation consumed by DriveUniWAM for joint future prediction and planning.

paragraphs.en: We provide additional implementation details for the comparison in Table 2 . The protocol matches the representation exposed to DriveUniWAM, allowing us to compare the downstream effectiveness of the unified and separate designs under matched representation and downstream computation budgets. DriveUniTok uses 584 unified tokens, initialized from 576 queries with spatial reference points and 8 queries with learned reference points. paragraphs.en: The architectural difference is the location and connectivity of cross-modal interaction. DriveUniTok uses one shared query sequence, allowing RGB, depth, and ego queries to exchange information through self- attention before temporal compression and the Variational Latent Bottleneck. The separate baseline uses independent RGB, depth, and ego streams: RGB queries attend only to RGB features, depth queries attend only to depth features, and ego queries do not attend to visual features. Each stream has its own query set, encoder stack, temporal compressor, and Variational Latent Bottleneck. The separate design therefore removes cross-modal interaction in the tokenizer rather than merely assigning different output slices to a shared encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 架构上的差异在于跨模态交互的位置与连接方式。 DriveUniTok 使用一条共享的查询序列，使 RGB、深度和自车查询能够在时间压缩与变分潜瓶颈之前通过自注意力交换信息。 分离式基线使用独立的 RGB、深度和自车流：RGB 查询只关注 RGB 特征，深度查询只关注深度特征，自车查询不关注视觉特征。 每条流拥有自己的查询集合、编码器堆栈、时间压缩器和变分潜瓶颈。 因此，分离式设计是在分词器中移除了跨模态交互，而不仅仅是给共享编码器分配不同的输出切片。

During tokenizer training on NAVSIM, intra-modal and cross-modal masks are sampled randomly for each training example. Intra-modal masking removes patches or tokens within an observed modality and reconstructs them from the remaining evidence in that modality. Semantic supervision refers to the training-only semantic feature reconstruction branch; when it is removed, the RGB DINO perceptual objective is retained, so the ablation affects only the semantic readout. paragraphs.en: The qualitative comparisons cover both vision-language-action and world-action modeling paradigms. Each group contains a front-view observation followed by predictions from AutoVLA and ReCogDrive (VLA methods), PWM (a world-action baseline), DriveUniWAM (Ours), and DriveUniWAM with reinforcement learning post-training. AutoVLA produces reasonable paths in straight-road scenes with simple geometry, but can under-steer at intersections and turns, resulting in large turning radii or endpoints that deviate from the ground-truth route. ReCogDrive generally makes better use of road topology, while PWM captures the broad scene-conditioned motion trend but can retain local curvature or endpoint errors in more demanding cases. DriveUniWAM further improves trajectory shape, turning curvature, and endpoint placement. After reinforcement learning post-training, the predicted paths show greater stability in complex intersections, turns, merges, and scenes with an explicit navigation direction: the model adjusts its direction earlier and better matches the ground-truth curvature, position, and final heading. Overall, the visualizations show that DriveUniWAM produces feasible trajectories across both comparison paradigms, while reinforcement learning post-training further improves their agreement with driving feasibility.
